title: General contractor registration.
officialText:
Any registered general contractor who has defaulted at or been found liable
after proceedings before the environmental control board or in an adjudication in criminal court of violations of any provisions
of this code relating to a stop work order, public health or safety, structural integrity, building in compliance with approved con-
struction documents or fire safety three times within any twenty-four-month period shall be subject to immediate suspension of
his or her registration, pending a hearing and determination at office of administrative trials and hearings (OATH) or its
successor agency, as applicable.
